scope.summary: Closed the source-side gap between authored four-level animated-crossfade LOD structure and the global/runtime LOD state that actually selects and blends those levels during formal temporal evidence.

verification: Fresh branch check at run start confirmed gpt/unity-migration HEAD 77a540a1e54b3c74eb4a9d7e237187910ebc140b.
No GitHub Actions workflow run or commit-status context existed for the start HEAD, so no Unity Runner/runtime evidence was available and no visual score was assigned.

Source audit found that DanchiHighDetail already authored LOD0/1/2/3 with CrossFade + animateCrossFading and the previous run bound mesh/material/physical-UV continuity, but formal temporal provenance did not pin QualitySettings.enableLODCrossFade, QualitySettings.lodBias, QualitySettings.maximumLODLevel, LODGroup.crossFadeAnimationDuration, quality-level identity, or the live LOD renderer assignments across the sequence.

Unity 6 API verification confirmed that QualitySettings.enableLODCrossFade globally enables/disables LOD cross-fade, lodBias and maximumLODLevel globally alter LOD selection, and LODGroup.crossFadeAnimationDuration is the global duration used by animated cross-fading.

Added a machine-readable temporal-lod-runtime-state-v1 contract requiring global cross-fade enabled, maximumLODLevel=0, finite lodBias>=1, positive finite cross-fade animation duration, four animated CrossFade levels at the authored 0.18/0.08/0.03/0.008 transitions, strictly reducing renderer counts, exact canonical critical-defect IDs, manual pixel review, and zero automatic Visual Fidelity points.

Added an InitializeOnLoad formal temporal pre-cull guard. While QualityBlockTemporalRuntimeEvidenceGuard is armed, the guard establishes a SHA-256 baseline from quality-level identity, global LOD controls, DanchiHighDetail world transform, LODGroup size/reference point/fade policy, per-level transitions/fade widths, renderer counts and sorted renderer assignments, then requires that exact state before every MainCamera cull.

The guard invokes existing Detail LOD Physical UV QA at sequence entry so runtime LOD state and previously enforced shared mesh/material/metric-UV continuity are both prerequisites for formal temporal evidence.

Self-audit removed a redundant double SHA-256 rebuild on every post-first pre-cull and replaced the initial C# using-declaration with the classic using block to reduce language-version compatibility risk.

Fail-closed hardening disables the required QualityBlockFilmicTonemap if LOD-state validation throws. Therefore even if an engine callback exception does not abort Camera.Render immediately, the existing temporal runtime telemetry cannot later satisfy its one-tonemap-invocation-per-frame evidence requirement.
No Unity 6000.3.0f1 compile/runtime claim is made. The new class/API references and the actual default/current project LOD quality state remain runtime verification pending.
expectedVisualScoreImpact: Temporal/LOD/aliasing stability (5): increases provenance confidence that formal temporal evidence is not captured with global LOD cross-fade disabled, LOD0 skipped, lodBias changed, cross-fade duration changed, or a different Danchi LOD assignment. No points without rendered motion evidence.

Texture/microdetail/texel fidelity (10): protects the previously implemented metric physical-UV/phase continuity from being evaluated under a different live LOD selector during the temporal sequence. No points without actual 100% crops.
Material/PBR physical plausibility (20): keeps shared material/microstructure continuity tied to the same selected LOD topology while temporal evidence is rendered. No points without actual pixels.
Critical defects: specifically reduces provenance risk for visible_lod_pop and severe_aliasing_or_shimmer, but does not auto-clear either defect.
knownLimitations: This run does not prove that any positive cross-fade duration is perceptually sufficient; only actual temporal render evidence can do that.
The new guard is source-side and Editor-callback based. Actual Unity 6000.3.0f1 compilation and callback/telemetry interaction are unverified until a Runner exists.
No native 3840x2160 temporal frames, 100% crops, shimmer measurements, or visible-LOD-pop review were produced in this run.
Implementation Readiness remains 93/100; the missing 7 points remain reserved for real Unity compile/runtime verification.
